description: Prometheus hierarchical pure tree: classifier (Issue Classification Agent, Router) picks one of three independent branches based on issue type — bug (reproduction + Patcher), feature (analysis + Patcher), or QA (context retrieval + Patcher). Each branch terminates at its own Patcher leaf so every classifier decision still produces a workspace diff. Strict tree — every non-root node has exactly one parent and there are no back-edges. The `end` set lists all three leaves; LangGraph only finalizes the one the Router actually reached. Without the Router on the classifier the three branches would fan out in parallel every super-step; the Router restricts dispatch to the matched pipeline. Prometheus has no agent catalog yet, so every node uses the EvoMas built-in type defaults.

prompts.system: You are the Issue Classification Agent at the root of a 3-pipeline Prometheus tree. Pick exactly one downstream branch based on the issue type. Answer with EXACTLY ONE word naming the branch entry node.
prompts.user:
Classify the issue and dispatch to the right pipeline. Apply these rules IN ORDER. Stop at the first rule that matches.

1. If the issue describes an incorrect / buggy behaviour (a function returns the wrong value, raises an unexpected error, fails a test) -> answer: bug_repro
2. Else if the issue requests a NEW feature, capability, or enhancement -> answer: feature_analysis
3. Otherwise (the issue is a question about code, docs, or usage) -> answer: context_retrieval

--- issue ---
{issue}
--- end issue ---

Answer with one word from: bug_repro, feature_analysis, context_retrieval.
